subject: Signal and System
questionText:
A system with the impulse response h(t) = 6 (t + 5)
(a)
has memory and is stable
(b) does not have memory and is unstable
(c)
has memory and is unstable
(d) none of the above

options.text: does not have memory and is unstable

explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-10 (LTI System and Its Properties).
